args.lesson: PUBLISH_SITE dry_run works without Cloudflare credentials and returns a review_digest. That turns the vague hosting blocker into two concrete founder tasks: a credential, and an independent APPROVE of that digest. Next time, build products/sites/<name> and dry-run it early instead of probing access. Verify the page markup after scripted injection: the first pass put the disclosure before the doctype, and the llms.txt claimed checks the code does not do. Files deleted in the sandbox may persist in published products (dry run counted 3 files, not 2).
